Resolves #20896

The wheel now zooms toward the pointer. `onWheel` computes the new distance as before (same clamp to `zoom.min`/`zoom.max`), then moves `camera.target` with it so the point of the target's depth plane under the pointer keeps its canvas position. The move comes from a new pure static helper beside `flightStep`, `GraphScene.zoomTarget({aspect, camera, dist, fov, height, width, x, y})`: it shifts the target along the view's right and up axes by `(oldDist - newDist) * tan(fov / 2)` times the pointer's offset from the centre in normalized device coordinates (times the aspect on x). With the pointer at the centre, or a distance the clamp leaves unchanged, the shift is zero, so today's behaviour is the special case. Zooming out reverses the move.

The pointer position comes from `mouse`, which `Base.updateMouseState` fills from the wheel report before it calls `onWheel` (a report without a position keeps the last one). No pointer position yet (idle `mouse`), no `canvasSize`, or the new `zoomToPointer: false` config keeps the old zoom toward the target.

Evidence: L1 (unit arms in `test/playwright/unit/canvas/GraphScene.spec.mjs`) → L1 required for the in-repo ACs. Residual: the consumer walk (post-merge).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `a wheel step keeps the point of the target's depth plane under the pointer in its place, closing in and backing off`: two cameras (yaw/pitch 0, and yaw 1.1 / pitch 0.4 with an off-origin target), a point right of and below the centre projects to the same canvas position after a step in (dist 2) and out (dist 15); at the centre and with an unchanged distance the target does not move. Red on `dev` (`zoomTarget` does not exist). |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `the wheel zooms toward the pointer; ...`: a wheel past `zoom.min` holds the distance at `fittedDistance * zoom.min`, and a further wheel with the pointer elsewhere leaves the target where it is. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: same arm: the wheel clears `flightPlan`, sets `camera.touched` and calls `requestFrame` once. |
| AC-4 | Already true on `dev`: `PointerInput` sends the canvas-relative `x`/`y` beside `wheel` (`wheel carries the deltas beside the position` in `PointerInput.spec.mjs`), and `Base.updateMouseState` puts it into `mouse` before `onWheel`. So `src/main/DomEvents.mjs` needs no change. The renderer arm drives the wheel through `updateMouseState`, the real entry. |
| AC-5 | JSDoc of `onWheel`, of `zoomTarget`, of the new `zoomToPointer` config, and the class header's camera paragraph ("the wheel zooms toward the pointer"). |
| AC-6 | Post-merge, consumer (below). |

## Deltas from ticket
- The off switch is a separate `zoomToPointer: true` config, not a key inside `zoom`: a consumer that already sets its own `zoom` object (the Observatory runs `zoom.min` 0.1) would otherwise turn the new behaviour off without knowing.
- The existing flight arm's `onWheel({wheel: {deltaY: 100}})` runs with an idle `mouse`, so it still zooms toward the target and its assertions are unchanged.
- `src/canvas/GraphScene.mjs` is over the size target; its baseline row moves from 1048 to 1078 code lines.

size-guard-growth: src/canvas/GraphScene.mjs — zoomTarget helper and its use in onWheel for the wheel-toward-pointer zoom (#20896)

## Test Evidence
`test/playwright/unit/canvas` (GraphScene, PointerInput, the rest): 67 pass. Both new arms fail on `dev` and pass with the change. `check-file-sizes --base origin/dev` with this body, `check-block-alignment`, `check-shorthand`, `check-jsdoc-types`, `check-parse`: clean.

Local full unit tier: 7085 pass, 3 skipped. 3 fail the same way without this change: `gitignoreNegationReachability.spec.mjs` and `helperCallGuardHook.spec.mjs` (local clone setup) and the SEO rebuild test (timeout under full load).
